item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"By the end of July 2023, fines for failing to attend BAMF revocation hearings had been issued in only four cases and no subsequent hearings had been held. In 2023, 89.9% of completed revocation or withdrawal procedures resulted in no revocation or withdrawal, and 2,040 persons were affected by a revocation or withdrawal decision.","notes":["The cited excerpt does not include the claim that 109,044 procedures remained pending at year-end; that appears in the subsequent excerpt."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R06-E014","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The report stated that German law lacked provisions for adequate support throughout the asylum procedure for applicants needing special procedural guarantees. It also reported that legal guardians for unaccompanied minors lacked specific asylum-law training and that airport procedures did not exempt unaccompanied children or persons needing special procedural guarantees as required under relevant EU rules.","notes":["The excerpt supports the lack of adequate-support provisions, guardians’ lack of specific training, and the airport-procedure exemptions claim, but it does not include the broader claim that German law did not systematically identify vulnerable applicants except unaccompanied children."]}]}
